subject: GREEN: minimal ecall dispatch (handler.c hook + linux/syscall.c) + main.c wiring
description: Add weak handle_ecall() hook to runtime/handler.c (mcause==11 from M-mode; default false = today's fatal path, vplat unaffected). Implement it in runtime/linux/syscall.c for write(64)->_write, exit/exit_group(93/94)->_exit, else unhandled. Wire main.c: when g_manifest.app_path is non-empty, load_elf + build_stack + asm jump to entry with the built sp (naked trampoline, sets sp then jumps, never returns).
activeForm: Wiring ecall dispatch and the app-launch path
